description: Use this skill for ANY writing, persuasion, communication, or content creation task — blog posts, cold emails, pitch decks, scripts, tweets, landing pages, essays, cover letters, sales copy, storytelling, speeches, proposals, or any text meant to change what someone thinks, feels, or does. Also use when the user asks for help with prompting, prompt engineering, or getting better outputs from AI. Trigger whenever the user says "write", "draft", "convince", "persuade", "pitch", "explain to", "sell", "position", "frame", "story", "narrative", "content", "copy", "script", "email", "post", "article", or any variant. This skill treats writing as applied psychology and world-building — not self-expression. If someone needs words that WORK on a reader, use this skill.
